entities.summary: Andrey Ilyich Fursov is a Soviet Russian historian and author, Candidate of History Sciences. Member of the Union of Writers of Russia (2010). From 1997 to 2006, Fursov headed the Institute of Russian History. He headed a department at Moscow State University.
